记录你复制过的**文本**，方便回头再拿一次。默认关闭；: Keeps the text you copy so you can grab it again. Off by default;
， 不参与备份 / WebDAV 同步；不记图片、不记文件列表；随时可以一键清空: , never included in backups / WebDAV sync; no images, no file lists; clear it any time.
